lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately six visible vertical columns across the mid-lateral flank, forming a roughly rectangular grid pattern.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating discernible grid-like anchor nodes along the flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, high-luminance blobs concentrated primarily on the lower half of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: High-density clustering of small, high-luminance spots on the distal surface of the visible pectoral fin.
